title: Are you trying to sign in?
lead: A device has typed your master password and is waiting for your confirmation.
placeNote: Approximate location, based on the IP address
unknownPlaceNote: It could not be worked out from the IP address
gone: The sign-in request is no longer pending.
choose: Choose the number shown on the other device
chooseHint: If it is you, you are looking at it on its screen right now.

wrongNumber.one: That is not the number. Look at the other device’s screen: you have {count} attempt left.
wrongNumber.other: That is not the number. Look at the other device’s screen: you have {count} attempts left.

wrongNumberPlain: That is not the number. Look at the other device’s screen before choosing.
notMe: If you are not signing in anywhere, someone knows your master password.

approved.title: Done, you have approved the sign-in
approved.body: “{device}” can now get into your account. From now on it is a trusted device.
approved.bodyNoName: The other device can now get into your account. From now on it is a trusted device.
approved.undo: If that was a mistake, deauthorise it in Settings, under Devices.

denied.title: You have denied the sign-in
denied.body: That device did not get in. But to come this far someone typed your master password correctly: it is no longer a secret.
denied.next: Change it now. Your vault is still encrypted and nobody could read it, but a password someone else knows no longer protects you.

deniedByAttempts.title: We have denied the sign-in
deniedByAttempts.body: The number chosen did not match for the second time, so the request was denied for your security.
deniedByAttempts.retry: If it was you, sign in again on the other device and look closely at the number it shows.
deniedByAttempts.notYou: If it was not you, someone knows your master password: change it.

resolved.title: This request is no longer pending
resolved.body: It was answered from another device, completed another way, or it expired. There is nothing you need to do.

none.title: There is nothing to confirm
none.body: This sign-in request has already been answered or has expired.

alerts.title: Sign-in alerts
alerts.label: Alert me with a browser notification
alerts.description: When another device tries to sign in and this tab is in the background, you will see a notification. It does not include the number or the device name.
alerts.denied: The browser is blocking notifications from AccioPass. Allow them in the site settings and turn this on again.
alerts.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
alerts.notificationTitle: Are you trying to sign in?
alerts.notificationBody: Open AccioPass to confirm or deny the sign-in.
